hero.lead: Freedom requires responsibility. Success requires solidarity. What I observe daily in my work: economy and society are not opposites – they depend on each other.

band: Solidary liberalism · Economy as a tool of society · Dialogue instead of polarisation

haltung.label: Stance
haltung.h2: A new balance between economy, state and society.
haltung.lead: The old ideological camps are reaching their limits. We need a model that builds bridges instead of trenches.

p1.p: Companies should develop freely – with the readiness to bear social responsibility. Not as a constraint, but as an attitude.

p2.p: The state sets fair rules and invests where markets fail. It enables – it does not direct.

p3.p: Economic success is not an end in itself. It should provide people with security, opportunities and quality of life.

antreibt.label: What drives me
antreibt.quote: "Those who take responsibility deserve freedom. Those who only optimise contribute to social erosion."
antreibt.p: I look for solutions beyond party lines – and believe in economic freedom as a tool for society. I experience this every day: in consultations, in advocacy, in contact with startups and politics. The answer lies not in ideology, but in dialogue.

b1.p: As a neuropsychologist I have learned: behind every position lies a need. Whoever understands the person can talk to them – even if you don't share the same opinion. This principle shapes how I conduct conversations and how I assess political positions.

b2.p: Five years of data science at the anti-money laundering reporting office taught me one thing: good decisions need evidence, not ideology. Sometimes 'not yet decided' is the most precise answer – and that is not a weakness.

b3.p: In daily political life I experience that the fundamental needs of all parties are more similar than the rhetoric suggests. The difference lies not in the what, but in the how. I look for the common denominator – not as a compromise, but as a starting point.

b4.h3: Talking is good. Building is better.
b4.p: With Sublingua and Fizzi & the Prof! I am building things I would have needed myself: rethinking learning, making knowledge accessible. Convictions you don't act on are merely opinions.

b5.p: My dog keeps me grounded. Someone who has to trust a creature that doesn't speak every single day learns to listen differently.

k1.p: Dialogue before polarisation. Economy in service of society. Responsibility instead of ideology.

k2.p: Trust is built through conscious communication – not by chance.

k3.p: Rethinking education – with neuropsychology, animation and genuine joy of learning.

kontakt.sub: Whether political engagement, project collaboration or just an exchange – I look forward to hearing from you.
kontakt.success: Thank you for your message – I'll be in touch soon.

projekte.sub: Education deserves the same innovative spirit as entertainment. Here concrete answers take shape.
projekte.warum_h2: What I believe, I must also be able to do.
projekte.warum_p1: I advocate politically that education is a public good – and that investment should go where markets alone fail. At the same time, as an entrepreneur, I believe that innovation cannot wait for state initiative. Sublingua and Fizzi & the Prof! are my answer to this demand: concrete implementations of what I know as a neuropsychologist about learning – and what I hold to be politically right.
projekte.warum_p2: Both projects arise not from market analyses, but from experience. I would have needed these offerings myself. To me that is the most solidary form of entrepreneurship: creating something you missed yourself – and making it accessible.
projekte.k1_p: Deepening consciously learned material through unconscious stimulation. Neuropsychology meets language learning.
projekte.k2_p: Learning for all ages – through identification with characters, a positive error culture and a calm atmosphere.
projekte.antrieb_p1: The entertainment industry invests billions in attention – education deserves the same ambition. Those who take equal opportunity seriously must also work on the quality of what is offered, not just its accessibility.
projekte.antrieb_p2: Sublingua and Fizzi & the Prof! are the attempt to do just that. Not as a stopgap for state failure – but as proof that it works.

sublingua.sub: Deepening consciously learned material through unconscious stimulation.
sublingua.idee_h2: The brain learns even when we don't notice.
sublingua.idee_p1: Sublingua uses modern neuropsychological research to make learning more efficient. Through subliminal stimulation – unconscious stimuli in everyday life – consciously learned content is anchored more deeply in memory and better connected.
sublingua.idee_quote: How can the brain be effectively trained even outside active learning phases?
sublingua.idee_p2: The project grew out of studies in neuropsychology, perception and social psychology at the University of Bern – and the conviction that education can do more than it does today.
sublingua.step1_p: Regular learning phase – language course, lessons, independent practice.
sublingua.step2_p: Unconscious stimuli in everyday life anchor what has been learned – without extra effort.
sublingua.step3_p: The brain links actively and passively learned content – seamless integration into everyday life.
sublingua.phase1_p: Collaboration with language schools after regular courses.
sublingua.phase2_p: Individualised app, adaptable to different learning needs.
sublingua.phase3_p: Expansion to further learning areas beyond language learning.

fizzi.sub: Learning is not a duty – it's an adventure.
fizzi.band: Identification · Calm atmosphere · Positive error culture · All ages
fizzi.idee_h2: Learning rarely fails because of the content.
fizzi.idee_p: It fails because of attitude. Too much pressure, too little meaning, too little connection. Fizzi & the Prof! builds bridges: between knowledge transfer and real experience, between character and viewer, between school and the joy of understanding.
fizzi.idee_quote: Education deserves the same innovative spirit as entertainment.
fizzi.figuren_p: The series lives from characters that embody real learning moments – curiosity, doubt, joy, insight.
fizzi.fizzi_p: Young fox. Curious, brave, sometimes unsure. Stands for the learner in all of us.
fizzi.pico_p: Little blue bird. Quiet companion, gentle wit, always by Fizzi's side.
fizzi.prof_p: Older fox with glasses. Calm teaching figure – explains without pressure, asks rather than demands.
fizzi.maana_p: Wise owl. Appears rarely – and when she does, with weight and deep meaning.
fizzi.stil_h2: A world where you can breathe.
fizzi.stil_p: Soft coloured pencil style, calm natural tones, warm contrasts. No sensory overload, no fast cuts. The settings – fox den, learning place under the tree, clearing, dream forest – provide security and orientation.
fizzi.zielgruppe_p: Learning never stops. Fizzi & the Prof! grows with its viewers.
fizzi.wf1_p: Characters you like and recognise yourself in.
fizzi.wf2_p: No stress, no time pressure. Learning is allowed to be slow.
fizzi.wf3_p: Fizzi makes mistakes. And learns from them. That's the point.

politik.h1:
For a politics that first listens,
understands and then moves together.
politik.sub: I am a Constructive Democrat. I look for solutions beyond party lines – because economy and society need not contradict each other. Solidary liberalism is one of my tools. An attitude that works left and right.
politik.band: Solidary liberalism · Bridges not trenches · Responsibility not ideology
politik.ausgangslage_h2: Society is not a zero-sum game.
politik.ausgangslage_p: The political models of the 20th century are reaching their limits. Climate change, digitalisation, demographic change and growing inequality demand new thinking.
politik.sd_p: Security and opportunity for all. But national answers are no longer enough for global dynamics.
politik.lib_p: Entrepreneurship and prosperity. But the social costs were underestimated.
politik.sl_p: Freedom with consequences. Economy as a tool of society – not as an adversary.
politik.kernthesen_quote: Responsibility is not the opposite of freedom – it is its condition.
politik.th1_p: Economy is a tool – to enable quality of life, stability and innovation. Companies that create social value deserve the strongest framework conditions.
politik.th2_p: Solidary liberalism is not a left or right idea. Entrepreneurial freedom and social responsibility do not exclude each other – they condition each other. Those who accept this can advocate this approach regardless of their party affiliation.
politik.th3_p: Complex systems need dialogue, differentiation and willingness to learn. In my work I observe daily: the fundamental needs of all parties are more similar than the rhetoric suggests.
politik.dr1_p: Creates rules that enable fairness and stability. Enables – does not direct.
politik.dr2_p: Responsibility beyond pure profit. Location loyalty as strength, not weakness.
politik.dr3_p: Participates, monitors and actively shapes. Democracy as everyday practice.
politik.dreiklang_quote: Effect arises through attitude, not coercion.
politik.manifest_p: I have developed solidary liberalism: with mechanism, sectors, historical roots and legal foundations. Version 1.0, May 2026.
politik.kompass_p: 6 questions on economy and society – and you'll see on a compass how your stance compares to mine.

kommunikation.sub: Communication goes beyond words – it manifests in attitude, structure and attention.
kommunikation.haltung_p1: I observe daily how well-intentioned conversations fail – not because positions are incompatible, but because communication is lacking. In Switzerland, this is not a personal weakness but a structural problem: we are a nation of will – no common people, no common language, no common heritage – but a common will. This will needs cultivation. It does not arise on its own, and it dies when we stop talking to each other.
kommunikation.haltung_p2: For a long time, the inertia of our direct democracy was a protective wall. Radical currents could not take the fundamental order by storm – the people were the corrective, and their slowness was a strength. Today it is different. Digital spaces bring global currents into every home: disinformation, division, targeted influence. What used to bounce off at our border lands today directly on the smartphone – and targets what holds us together.
kommunikation.haltung_p3: My answer is not counter-propaganda, but understanding. Whoever has truly listened to the other side can find a common denominator with them. Structured communication – listening, clarifying, deciding together – is not a soft skill. It is the foundation on which direct democracy still works in the 21st century.
kommunikation.grundsatz_p: Unspoken assumptions and different visions of objectives often hinder understanding more than content differences. Good facilitation creates space for shared solutions.
kommunikation.g1_p: Clarity about conversation goals and transparency about expectations and roles.
kommunikation.g2_p: Early recognition of dynamics. Hearing what is not said.
kommunikation.g3_p: Develop solutions and make clear agreements. Not talk – act.
kommunikation.methode_p: Every conversation follows an inner logic. Those who know it, lead more consciously.
kommunikation.ph1_p: What should this conversation achieve? A clear goal prevents talking past each other.
kommunikation.ph2_p: What does each party expect? Unspoken expectations are the most frequent source of disappointment.
kommunikation.ph3_p: Actively collecting all viewpoints – before judging or deciding.
kommunikation.ph4_p: Stay on topic, name deviations, consciously control the pace.
kommunikation.ph5_p: Together, not against each other. Creativity arises in a safe space.
kommunikation.ph6_p: Make clear agreements. Who does what by when? Without that, everything remains intention.
kommunikation.regeln_p: Good conversations don't happen by chance. These rules make the difference.
kommunikation.r1_p: Whoever is interrupted doesn't feel heard. Whoever doesn't feel heard doesn't listen. The cycle begins with the first interruption.
kommunikation.r2_p: Criticise the content, never the person. Whoever confuses the two loses their counterpart – and the argument.
kommunikation.r3_p: An opinion without justification is an assertion. Whoever explains their view invites the other to understand it – or meaningfully question it.
kommunikation.r4_p: Listening is not waiting for your turn to speak. It means truly understanding what the other person means – even between the lines.
kommunikation.r5_p: Digressions cost time and energy. Whoever holds the topic protects the shared goal of the conversation.
kommunikation.r6_p: Differences divide, commonalities connect. Whoever first looks for what connects creates ground for genuine dialogue.
kommunikation.r7_p: Escalation is easy. De-escalation requires attitude. Whoever stays calm in a moment of tension takes responsibility for the conversation.
kommunikation.r8_p: Open questions open. Closed ones close. Whoever asks rather than asserts shows genuine interest – and gets genuine answers.
kommunikation.r9_p: Leave hierarchy outside the room. In conversation, the argument counts, not the title.
kommunikation.r10_p: Whoever briefly sees the world through other eyes understands more – and judges less. Perspective-taking is not a sign of weakness, but of strength.
kommunikation.quote_final: The goal is cooperative problem-solving – not confrontation.

lernkonzept.sub: Behind Fizzi & the Prof! is more than animation. A didactic system built on neuropsychology, identification, and an understanding of the learning environment.
lernkonzept.band: Identification · Positive Error Culture · Learning Ecosystem · All Age Groups
lernkonzept.aus_h2: Learning isn't a question of ability. It's a question of permission.
lernkonzept.aus_p1: Children learn naturally. They ask questions, try things, fail, try again. This natural learning is inhibited – not promoted – by pressure, evaluation, and comparison. Fizzi & the Prof! steps in where school often stops: experiencing learning as something beautiful, communal, and meaningful.
lernkonzept.aus_quote: It's not the child who must adapt to learning. It's learning that must adapt to the child.
lernkonzept.aus_p2: This principle applies to all age groups. Whether four or forty – anyone who learns needs safety, belonging, and the feeling: I can do this. I belong here.
lernkonzept.oeko_p: Research is clear: the greatest influence on learning success lies not in the content, but in the environment. Parents, siblings, friends, teachers – they all shape whether learning is experienced as a burden or as a journey of discovery. Fizzi & the Prof! therefore addresses all those involved – not just the learners themselves.
lernkonzept.oeko1_p: Finds characters who feel the same way. Can doubt, fail, question – without fear.
lernkonzept.oeko2_p: Parents, siblings, peers experience it together. Understand what support without pressure looks like.
lernkonzept.oeko3_p: Receive a complementary tool: content delivered in a safe, calm atmosphere.
lernkonzept.oeko_quote: The goal is not to school the child. The goal is to create a community that learns together.
lernkonzept.fig_h2: Every character carries a role. Every role carries a message.
lernkonzept.fig_p: The four main characters are no coincidence. They embody the most important roles in the learning environment – and model how these roles can be filled in healthy, supportive ways.
lernkonzept.fizzi_p1: Fizzi is curious, brave – and sometimes unsure. Just like real learners. Children and adults see themselves in Fizzi: the desire to understand, the fear of failure, the joy of discovery. Fizzi makes mistakes. And that's the most important thing: he keeps going.
lernkonzept.fizzi_b: Mistakes are part of the process. Curiosity is strength.
lernkonzept.pico_p1: Pico is always there – quiet, loyal, never judgmental. He embodies the ideal learning companion: a friend who doesn't explain, but encourages. Who doesn't evaluate, but accompanies. Pico shows how peers can positively influence learning.
lernkonzept.pico_b: You don't have to learn alone.
lernkonzept.pino_p1: Professor Pino explains – but he doesn't demand. He asks rather than testing, waits rather than pushing. He embodies the ideal of the pedagogical relationship: teachers and parents who create space rather than filling it. His pace is the learner's pace.
lernkonzept.pino_b: Learning takes time. And time is a gift.
lernkonzept.maana_p1: Maana appears rarely – and when she does, it carries weight. She represents the inner voice, grandparents, mentors: those who don't explain, but contextualise. She gives meaning to what has been learned. She connects knowledge with wisdom.
lernkonzept.prinzip_p: Every design decision – pace, music, character reactions, exercise structure – follows one of these principles.
lernkonzept.p1_p: The child must first feel: That's like me. Then they can learn. Characters that show real emotions open this space.
lernkonzept.p2_p: Sensory overload inhibits processing. Calm images, soft music, and a slow pace activate the brain – without overwhelming it.
lernkonzept.p3_p: Fizzi makes mistakes publicly – and keeps going. Errors are not failure, but part of the process. This message is healing for all age groups.
lernkonzept.p4_p: Every lesson follows the same rhythm: ritual → delivery → exercise → movement → discovery → transfer. Predictability creates safety.
lernkonzept.p5_p: Content linked to positive emotions stays. Joy, wonder, discovery are not extras – they are the medium.
lernkonzept.p6_p: Repetition is not a sign of weak didactics – it is neuropsychologically necessary. Core concepts are deepened in a spiral fashion.
lernkonzept.p7_p: Videos are designed to be watched together – and to spark conversations. Learning as a social experience.
lernkonzept.vision_h2: Every person in a learner's environment is part of the learning. Fizzi & the Prof! makes this connection visible – and tangible.
lernkonzept.vision_p: The goal is not a better educational video. The goal is a culture in which learning is joyful again – for everyone involved.
